minutes.headline: Planning Board extended Highfield Village's decision date to Oct 22, 2013 and accepted the primary school land-swap ANR.
minutes.summary: The board heard committee reports, then extended the Highfield Village deadline while the developer awaits state environmental review and a Fitchburg sewer agreement. It accepted an ANR plan for a land swap at the Primary School. It also discussed board goals, public document access, the citizen survey, a medical marijuana moratorium, extension fees and lakefront beach acquisition. A goals workshop was set before the next meeting.

votes.motion: Extend Highfield Village decision date to October 22, 2013
Accept the ANR for 1417 Mass Ave land swap at the Primary School

budget_items.what_was_said: Assessed land values for the two parcels were read out; the board noted asking price was not at hand.
A member suggested tablets for board members, estimating cost across town boards.
The planning director surveyed neighbouring towns' fees for plan extensions; the board discussed levying one.
Assessed value of lots to extend the beach was discussed as a rough acquisition cost.
The planning director said funding must be found to update the rules and will talk to the town manager.

decisions.decision: Board will see Highfield Village again at its October 21 meeting, with the sewer commission invited.
Next meeting set with a goals workshop at 5:30 before the 6:30 meeting; later corrected to August 26.
The 300 West Holman Street Chapter 61B matter goes on the next agenda for discussion.
Public documents online will be read-only with no username and password required.
A medical marijuana question will be added to the citizen survey.
The director will draft a letter to the recreation committee and selectmen about the lakefront beach idea; board will vote once it is drafted.
The director will research the board's ability to comment on the Lunenburg Village project name.
The reviewing engineer's checklist will be updated to call out easements.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to extend its decision date on the Highfield Village development to late October 2013, with the developer still awaiting state environmental review and a Fitchburg sewer agreement.
The board will see Highfield Village again at its October meeting and plans to invite the sewer commission.
The board voted to accept an ANR plan for a land swap at the Primary School.
The board discussed charging a fee for plan extensions after the planning director surveyed neighbouring towns, and talked about the assessed value of lots next to the town beach.
The director will draft a letter to the recreation committee and selectmen on the lakefront beach idea, and a medical marijuana question will be added to the citizen survey.

why_it_matters: The Highfield Village decision depends on state environmental review and a sewer agreement with Fitchburg, so the timing of any new housing and its sewer connection remains open.
An extension fee, lakefront land purchases and funding to update subdivision and telecom rules could each reach the town budget, which is mostly taxes, and none has a cost or vote yet.
watch_next: Planning Board meeting with a goals workshop before it, where Highfield Village returns in October with the sewer commission invited.
A board vote on the lakefront beach letter once the director has drafted it.
